instruction: Launch Inkscape from Activities, create a new blank document, select the Text tool, click on the canvas and type "Vector Test 123". Set the text font size to 24 px and the fill color to #0000ff. Save the file as "vector_text.svg" in the Desktop/test_files folder.

verification.condition: Verify that ~/Desktop/test_files/vector_text.svg exists and its contents include the string "Vector Test 123" and style attributes containing both "font-size:24px" and "fill:#0000ff".
verification.expected_result: The SVG file is created at the specified path and contains a text element with the exact text "Vector Test 123", sized 24 px, filled with #0000ff.
